task.description: Hard gate on CODE-DESIGNER's ADR docs/migration/decisions/0044-hybrid-identity-model.md (committed at ade9a9dc on branch docs/ADR-hybrid-identity). Verify against the step-01 acceptance criteria. Method: (1) check every acceptance criterion with evidence from the file; (2) SPOT-VERIFY at least 15 file:line citations and at least 5 quoted passages from decisions 0002/0006/0035/0038/0042/0043 and security-invariants.md by opening the cited files in the worktree (quote what you found; any citation that does not match is a defect); (3) confirm no Keycloak capability is asserted as fact beyond the pinned version 26.2 (grep the Keycloak sections for assertions like 'supports', 'can', 'allows' and judge each); (4) confirm the per-REQ table covers REQ-434..444 and the statuses match docs/requirements.yaml; (5) confirm no implementation code; (6) confirm the decision number 0044 is free (ls docs/migration/decisions on origin/main via git ls-tree, and gh pr list for open PRs touching decisions/). Write your verdict into this handoff's 'result' (status PASS or FAIL, summary, issues[]) and set status COMPLETED. Do not spawn further agents.
